text: Submit a task via API call (client.runs.create) to run browser automation in the cloud
quote: run = client.runs.create("Find the top Hacker News story")

text: Launch a cloud browser and connect to it via its CDP URL, then stop it programmatically
quote: Launch a browser, connect to its CDP URL, then stop it

text: Task results are returned as a string; you can request JSON output and validate it yourself
quote: V4 returns `run.result` as a string. Ask for JSON only, then validate it client-side

text: A session preserves conversation state and its live browser across multiple runs
quote: A **session** holds the agent’s conversation and can reuse its live browser. One session ID can contain multiple runs.

text: Poll the events endpoint with a cursor to fetch only new run events instead of full history
quote: Poll `runs.events()` with the previous cursor to receive only new events

text: Cloud browsers run in a hardened, stealth-enabled Chromium fork by default with no configuration
quote: Every cloud browser session runs in a hardened Chromium fork with stealth enabled by default — no configuration needed.

text: Residential proxies across 195+ countries are enabled by default on cloud sessions
quote: Residential proxies are enabled by default across 195+ countries.

text: Every cloud browser automatically solves CAPTCHAs it encounters
quote: Every Browser Use Cloud browser enables automatic CAPTCHA solving.

text: A live preview lets a human take manual control if an automated challenge can't be solved
quote: If the challenge remains, open the [live preview](/cloud/browser/live-preview) for human control.

text: Log in once, save the browser profile, and reuse it so future sessions start already authenticated
quote: Log in once, save the profile, then reuse it to start future browsers already logged in.

text: Agent can pause at a 2FA prompt, hand off via live view URL for a human to enter the code, then resume the same session
quote: Ask the first run to stop at the 2FA screen, get its `live_view_url` from the [`browser.ready` event], and have the user enter the code. Then continue with the same session

text: Run browser automation from AI coding assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf via MCP
quote: Run browser automation tasks from your AI coding assistant. Connect to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client.

text: New eligible signups get a one-time $15 usage credit with no card required
quote: One-time $15 credit for eligible Google, GitHub or Microsoft signups ... No card required

text: Agent can complete a job application end-to-end using provided resume/info
quote: Task: "Fill in this job application with my resume and information."

text: Agent can extract structured data (e.g. followers) and export it as CSV
quote: Task: "Extract structured data about my followers and export it as a CSV."

text: Python library lets developers automate the web at scale from their own code with any LLM
quote: Want to automate the web at scale, from your own code, and with any LLM? Use the Python library
